prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Companion", "Log into your existing account to restore saved pets, or create a new account to keep your pet secure.", "Using a different email creates a separate profile without your existing pets.", "Existing User? Sign in to restore your pet"]
1: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Upload bright, well-lit photos facing forward for the best 3D pet generation results.", "Avoid blurry pictures or extreme angles.", "Choose clear pet photo", "Live Pet Model Preview"]
2: ["Testing Desktop Display", "We are verifying your display overlay settings so your pet can roam freely on screen.", "Test Mascot Display", "Pet is visible on screen!"]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Try these 3 quick actions to master controlling your pet right from your desktop.", "1. Double-click pet to open chat window", "2. Right-click pet to send to system tray", "3. Drag pet anywhere on screen", "Start Playing with Pet"]
4: []
5: ["Choose How You Want to Build Your Pet", "Pick quick adopt for pre-made pets (1 min) or custom creation (3 mins).", "Quick Adoption vs Custom Studio"]
6: ["Preparing Your Pet...", "We're painting animations and setting up your desktop companion.", "Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to access sound and interaction settings.", "Asset Generation"]
7: ["Having trouble signing in? Click below to retry connection or switch sign-in method.", "Troubleshoot Connection"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your new pet is officially registered.", "Celebration Animation", "Official Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Press Alt+P to summon/hide your pet. Right-click to adjust settings or feed. Click to chat!", "You can always access these controls from your system tray icon.", "Finish & Launch Pet"]
